race.comment: LATHLAIN (10) resumes. She promised plenty of ability in good company early doors which tapered off a bit but she is 2/2 fresh and won in dominant fashion at this track first up last campaign. Heavy track is no concern and she sets up for every chance. CASTELLITO (9) returned from a spell last start with a strong win by half a length over 1100m at this track. Profiles as an improver who can measure right up again. ZOURAIN (3) will find this a bit easier than some recent runs in town and can be hitting the line late from a wide draw. BARDIA'S DREAM (12) is coming off a narrow win here in a BM62 and can measure up again.
